notes: Status: procurement-stage enterprise opportunity. Heavy focus on Private VPC deployment and compliance mapping. CISO quote: "We cannot have third-party key custody or logs that are not auditable by our team" — strong BYOK requirement. Summary of compliance mapping: SOC2 Type II: need Redwood to provide latest Type II report, control mapping (CCM) and evidence for production controls (change mgmt, access reviews, incident response). ISO27001: require certificate + scope doc showing Redwood controls include the inference runtime; request statement of applicability. HIPAA/BAA: customer processes PHI for certain regulated clients; Redwood must sign BAA and demonstrate administrative, physical, technical safeguards (encrypted-at-rest, KMS with customer CMKs, access logging, role separation). Ask: specific log retention (customer requesting 7 years for certain records) — Redwood to propose retention tiers and export hooks to customer's SIEM (Splunk). PCI considerations: Lumencrest has a subset of ML flows that touch cardholder data (tokenization step). They require guidance on PCI scoping if Redwood handles any transient PAN, ideally a design where cardholder data is never written to Redwood-managed persistent storage (tokenize before call, or use redaction/pseudonymization). Redwood should provide PCI architecture guidance (SAQ A-EP vs SAQ D) and confirm support for TLS1.2+, endpoint hardening, and attestations. Network and deployment notes: customer will provide an AWS VPC (eu-west-1) with PrivateLink/VPC endpoints; no public internet egress from inference nodes allowed for production. Expect firewall rules, strict egress ACLs, and optional air-gapped on-prem node for highest-sensitivity tenants. KMS integration: BYOK with AWS KMS CMKs, HSM-backed keys, key rotation policy, and CloudTrail logs forwarded to customer account. Redwood to support envelope encryption and grant-based decrypt flow; provide KMIP/HSM options for on-prem. Audit logging: Redwood must produce structured, immutable audit logs for API calls, model versions, key usage (CMK decrypt/grant events), admin actions and provide daily export to customer's S3 + SIEM pipeline. Retention/immutability options required. Tests & validation: customer requires external pen-test summary, vulnerability scan cadence, and SOC2/ISO evidence. Legal/Procurement: BAA draft in progress; procurement wants explicit SLA on data residency, incident notification timelines (<=24 hours), and liability clauses. Next immediate asks: 1) final KMS design doc with grant flow and example CloudTrail logs, 2) updated architecture diagram showing network segmentation and PrivateLink endpoints, 3) SOC2 Type II pack + ISO27001 cert + pen-test summary, 4) draft BAA.
